name: Splithoof Crag
summary: Galak centaur patrol the northern cliffs of Splithoof Crag and guard their canyon stronghold. Their settlement surrounds Splithoof Hold, while they contest the ravine below the Grimtotem heights.

sections.title: A Galak Stronghold
sections.body: On the northern rock face of Thousand Needles, east of Darkcloud Pinnacle, Galak centaur keep their stronghold. Crude tents and dirt paths fill the enclave. Against the cliff stands Splithoof Hold, a cavern beneath the settlement. There, the Galak guard the Cloven Hoof, an ancient centaur relic kept beside a sacred brazier.

sections.title: Defending the Caverns
sections.body: Galak centaur attack travelers, Horde expeditions, and tauren scouts passing beneath their bluffs. The Grimtotem occupy nearby high pinnacles. Yet the Galak hold the canyon ravine and the caverns beneath its stone.

faq.answer: The Galak centaur tribe lives in Splithoof Crag, one of the prominent clans of Thousand Needles. The hostile Grimtotem tauren live nearby.
Splithoof Crag runs along the northern canyon wall of Thousand Needles, directly east of Darkcloud Pinnacle.
Splithoof Hold is the village's central cavern. Deep within, the Galak guard the Cloven Hoof, an ancient tribal artifact protected by a sacred flame in a brazier.

faq.q: Are the centaur here allied with the nearby Grimtotem?
faq.answer: No alliance between the Galak and Grimtotem is known. The Galak hold their canyon village and caverns, while the Grimtotem occupy the heights of Darkcloud Pinnacle.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know the long-standing hostility between your people and the centaur makes Splithoof Crag a concern. Horde scouts watch for hostile activity in Thousand Needles.
As a member of the Horde, you need the passage beneath the crags kept clear. It allows safe travel between the southern Barrens, Freewind Post, and the Shimmering Flats.
